svg.title: Pentago: game 1, move 1
svg.desc: Game 1 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden plays White and GitHub Black, under the Ghost Rule. Ghosts on b5 and a4. After G... b5: a ghost on b5, the centre of the upper left quarter. The Arbiter drew GitHub to set the first marble. It is GitHub's turn as Black, due by 27 Oct. The upper left quarter: a ghost on b5, a ghost on a4.
